title: Triage state at a defined cutoff
method: Synthetic 40-item review measured after two working days.24/40=60% have a service explanation at that cutoff. Pending and owner-missing items are distinct, and none is automatically classified as waste.
alt: Triage state at a defined cutoff. Service explanation: 24 changes; Shared analysis pending: 10 changes; Owner missing: 6 changes. Illustrative values.
